title: Local equal-rank dual-basis criterion for cup product
statement: Let f:X→S and j:W→S be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and E a finite locally free O_X-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Put p:X_W→W, q:X_W→X, N=p_*q^*E [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Assume the canonical adjunction unit at O_W is invertible, and N is finite locally free. Suppose each w∈W has an open neighbourhood U and a natural number r such that N|_U and E pulled to X_U are finite locally free of rank r. For the explicitly constructed cup transpose φ [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map], φ is invertible if and only if the adjunction counit p^*N→q^*E is invertible. No properness, flatness, or base-change compatibility is assumed in this local assertion.

source.place: final paragraph, perfect pairing and the two displayed mutually dual bases

proof.text: Unfold the explicit cup map as the curry of picardPushforwardPairing for M=q^*E and D=q^*(dual E), with the explicit pulled-back evaluation.

If the cup transpose is invertible, finite local freeness of its first direct-image factor gives a split counit by the perfect-pairing splitting theorem. The equal-local-ranks theorem upgrades this split monomorphism to an isomorphism.

Conversely, the explicit pulled-back evaluation is perfect because E is finite locally free. Apply the adjunction and invertible-counit theorem to conclude perfectness of the pushed pairing. Neither projection formula nor pullback-dual comparison is needed.

The transpose of the degree zero evaluation cup pairing is invertible exactly when the evaluation counit is invertible for vector bundles of the same rank

theorem picardCupProduct_isIso_iff_counit_of_local_ranks
    {X S W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (j : W ⟶ S)
    (hO : IsIso ((Classical.choose
      (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f j))).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hN : ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E)).IsFiniteLocallyFree)
    (hRanks : ∀ w : W, ∃ U : W.Opens, w ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ,
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
        ((Modules.tensorPullback U.ι).obj
          ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f j)).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E))) r ∧
      SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ j))).obj E) r) :
    IsIso (picardCupProductMap f E j hO) ↔
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f j))).counit.app
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f j)).obj E))
